summary: Unreconciled eco-tier credit aggregation on multi-model streaming invoice
description:
Issue summary:
Customer BrightCart reports that eco-tier credits (sustainability credits) are not aggregating consistently across a single finalized invoice that contains a mix of streaming chat + tool-invoke calls routed to two different model variants.

Impact:
- Customer sees a $1,200 discrepancy between console estimate and finalized invoice line for March 4–6 window.
- Invoice shows eco-tier credit applied on some lines but missing on others despite being eligible.
- Customer requesting immediate explanation and provisional credit while we investigate.

Environment:
- Dedicated account in us-east region.
- Workload: high-frequency streaming chat with intermittent tool calls and multi-model fallback routing.
- Billing window: 2026-03-04 to 2026-03-06.

Steps to reproduce / observed pattern:
1) Customer runs streaming sessions using redwood-v1-chat pinned variant with fallback to openlm/multi-embed-128 for certain tool calls.
2) Console estimate used eco-tier flag and displayed a -$780 eco credit across the sample window.
3) Finalized invoice shows eco credit -$780 on the embedding batch lines but not on streaming/chat lines; net invoice shows only -$100 eco credit.
4) Customer verified no plan change or promo alterations during window.

Expected behavior:
- Eco-tier credit should be applied consistently to eligible usage across all lines (streaming + tool invocations) and reflected in both console estimate and finalized invoice.

Actual behavior:
- Partial application: credits present on batch/embed line items, absent on streaming/chat lines that used the same eco-flagged routing.

Logs / evidence provided by customer:
- Attached console screenshots with estimate vs invoice (provided in customer email).
- CSV export of invoice lines and usage ids (CSV id: AZ-BC-20260306-usage.csv).
- Sample request ids: req_us1_72a9c, req_us1_72b2f, req_us1_72f33.

Notes:
- Customer is enterprise/dedicated and expects SLA response. Written request asks for provisional credit if root cause not identified within 24h.

2026-03-12 11:03 - Billing Eng (Samir Patel): Taking look — initial hypothesis: eco-tier credit enrollment flag may not be propagated for streaming tool call sub-requests during multi-model fallback. Investigating routing tags in postbacks.

2026-03-12 13:30 - SRE (Lina Zhou): Correlated request ids to postback events. Observed that two streaming sessions had interleaved fallback calls that created separate postback batches; one batch had eco tag, the other did not. Need to trace postback enrichment path.

2026-03-13 08:55 - Billing Eng (Samir Patel): Confirmed bug in postback composition during streaming/tool interleaving when quantized variant selection caused a tag drop. Preparing rollback and reconciliation plan.
2026-03-13 12:02 - Support (Miguel Ortega): Applied provisional credit of $1,000 to account (internal credit id CR-2026-03-13-214760). Will update with final reconciliation after billing run rerun.
investigation: Checked postback logs for provided request ids — found inconsistent tag enrichment on postback batches created by streaming multiplexer.
Found that when fallback to a quantized variant happened mid-stream, the postback aggregator created a new batch without inheriting the eco-tier flag from initial session metadata.
Console estimate uses real-time eligibility calculation at request time; invoice is produced from reconstructed postbacks. The mismatch arises when postback batches lose eligible tags.
Related PR discovered that changed postback dedupe behavior during last maintenance: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5421 touches the streaming mux postback code path.
resolution: Provisional credit of $1,000 applied on 2026-03-13 while engineering prepares a targeted fix. Engineering will deploy a hotfix to postback aggregator to ensure tag propagation (rollback plan ready). After hotfix and a one-time billing re-run, we will issue any remaining reconciliation credits and update invoice. Customer to be notified of final adjustment by 2026-03-16. Follow-up action: add automated test covering interleaved fallback + streaming to prevent regression (ticket INT-421002 created).
